//: Typecheck config for the notifications PURE-MODULE unit tests.
WHY IT EXISTS. `ags bundle` transpiles without type-checking, so a pure
helper that reads fine and is wrong in an edge case is a card that renders
wrong at runtime. The notifications cards' formatting + stage mapping now
live in `lib/card-model.ts` (pure: no `gi://*`, no `ags`),
so `node --test` runs the suite on a stock runner with no desktop stack.
SEPARATE FROM THE APP CONFIG, ON PURPOSE. This file typechecks the TESTS.
It needs @types/node for `node:test`/`node:assert`, and
`allowImportingTsExtensions` because the test files import the module under
test with an explicit `.ts` suffix (Node's ESM resolver does no
extensionless lookup). It deliberately does NOT widen to `gi://*` or
`ags/*`: nothing reachable from here may import GTK, which is what keeps
the suite runnable on a stock CI runner.
WHERE @types/node COMES FROM. This config is not wired into `make gates`
in v0.1.0; the suite itself is executed by `make test` with Node's native
type stripping. To typecheck it locally, install @types/node into THIS
directory's own node_modules (a SIBLING of the config: tsc's default
typeRoots walk starts here and walks UP). tests/node_modules/ is
gitignored.
`noEmit` is set: nothing here is ever emitted. These files are executed by
Node, not bundled by ags.
